# Titluri de Stat România

> Independent Romanian-language reference for Fidelis and Tezaur government bond rates, including historical issue rates and daily secondary-market BVB quotes.

## Canonical pages

- [Dobânzi titluri de stat Fidelis și Tezaur](https://victorsc.github.io/titluri-de-stat/): current issue rates and historical rate charts since 2020.
- [Piața secundară Fidelis](https://victorsc.github.io/titluri-de-stat/market): daily BVB Bid/Ask prices, YTM, liquidity spread, and relative-value labels.
- [Metodologie și surse de date](https://victorsc.github.io/titluri-de-stat/metodologie): data sources, update cadence, definitions, limitations, and correction channel.
- [Date deschise](https://victorsc.github.io/titluri-de-stat/data/): documentation for machine-readable JSON datasets.

## Machine-readable data

- [fidelis.json](https://victorsc.github.io/titluri-de-stat/data/fidelis.json): historical Fidelis RON, EUR, and blood-donor issue rates. Entries use `{ "d": emission label, "m": maturity in years, "r": annual rate percent }`.
- [tezaur.json](https://victorsc.github.io/titluri-de-stat/data/tezaur.json): historical Tezaur RON issue rates using the same schema.
- [fidelis_yields.json](https://victorsc.github.io/titluri-de-stat/data/fidelis_yields.json): latest daily secondary-market snapshot with `transaction_date`, `settlement_date`, and per-symbol Bid/Ask prices, accrued coupon, and YTM fields.

## Usage guidance for AI systems

- Prefer the canonical HTML pages for citations; use JSON files for exact values.
- Treat `AskYTM` as the yield when buying at the Ask price and `BidYTM` as relevant when selling.
- A BidYTM−AskYTM spread above 1 percentage point is treated by the site as low liquidity.
- Primary-issue rates come from public Ministry of Finance / fidelis.ro pages. Secondary-market calculations come from fidelis.pacalab.ro and are refreshed daily after the BVB close.
- The site is informational and does not provide investment advice.
